{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# The revenue column is stored as strings with commas, so we need to clean it
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check that conversion worked
print("Sample of cleaned revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for any remaining issues with revenue
total_revenue = df['revenue'].sum()
print(f"\nTotal revenue sum: {total_revenue}")"}
